notes: No branding of any third-party platform.
Customers and merchants are synthetic / anonymized.
Holdout scenarios are for organizer evaluation only; participants should not train on them.
Language field indicates preferred UI language / code-mix.
Dynamic discount must respect merchant max_discount_pct and min_margin_pct.
Geospatial: all coordinates are in Bengaluru; use haversine for distance.
Labeled holdout is organizer-only. Blind holdout (no answers) may be given to participants for practice or leaderboard.
Evaluation has two stages: (1) automated backend on holdout, (2) live web demo + pitch to judges.
